description_en: Add or remove an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance from data sharing
description_zh: 将AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版实例加入数据共享或从数据共享中移除
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb set-data-share-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --operation-type add --instance-list gp-bp000000000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetDataShareInstance

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86912.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86912.html接口查看可用的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable or disable data sharing. Valid values:

add: enables data sharing.
remove: disables data sharing
parameters.help_zh:
在数据共享中添加或移除实例。取值说明：

add：将实例添加至数据共享中。
remove：将实例从数据共享中移除
parameters.name: operation_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance in Serverless mode.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the details of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a specific region, including instance IDs
parameters.name: instance_list

ErrMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the operation fails

Status.description_en:
The state of the operation. Valid values:

success: The operation is successful.
failed: The operation fails
Status.description_zh:
状态。取值说明：

success：成功。
failed：失败
